ns2:section.sectionText: This online section is restricted to Illinois College of Business students who will be participating in BUS Study Abroad; Business Minor students; and Hoeft Technology and Management minor students. BUS Study Abroad students should contact finregistration@business.illinois.edu for information on how to register. Online FIN 221 has a prerequisite of Accy 200, or Accy 201 and 202.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technology and Management or Business minor(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
